purpose: Defines shared type declarations, enums, and utility functions for video frame-rate scaling, shuttle tracking, pose estimation, and rally segmentation across pipeline stages. Establishes common data structures for contacts, serve configuration, and sticky-picker results.

public_api.name: ScalingKind
public_api.role: StrEnum that declares how base-30 values scale with video FPS (per-frame speed shrinks, frame counts grow, dimensionless stays fixed); callers use the .scale() method to convert values to target FPS.

public_api.name: ScalingKind.scale
public_api.role: Instance method that scales a single base-30 value to the target frame rate.

public_api.name: DeadMaskMode
public_api.role: StrEnum to select the policy (REPLAY, COMPOSITION, or UNION) for generating per-frame dead-time masks.

public_api.name: SmoothingMode
public_api.role: StrEnum to select how invisible frames are treated during span smoothing (ZERO_FILL or IGNORE_INVISIBLE).

public_api.name: SpanOpen
public_api.role: StrEnum to control where a rally span opens during segmentation: REGION_START or BACK_FILL, passed to segment_video().

public_api.name: ReentryGuardVariant
public_api.role: StrEnum to select which sides of a high-shot gap the re-entry buffer tests (TWO_SIDED or REENTRY_ONLY).

public_api.name: ContactCandidate
public_api.role: NamedTuple holding a raw contact candidate and its independent gate/suppression verdicts (rally_id, contact_frame, proximity_ok, wrist_near, suppressed).

public_api.name: ServeStartConfig
public_api.role: NamedTuple specifying serve-start policy with threshold in body-height multiples, mode, optional close variant, and stillness threshold.

public_api.name: Slot
public_api.role: IntEnum for storage row indices (TOP=0, BOTTOM=1) aligned with sticky_anchor's public constants; used to index per-slot arrays directly.

public_api.name: compute_speed
public_api.role: Function that computes per-frame shuttle speed from a (t, 3) track array; returns (t,) speed in norm-units/frame, NaN where steps are not fully visible.

public_api.name: true_runs
public_api.role: Function that extracts maximal contiguous runs of True values from a boolean mask as half-open [start, end) ranges; used for detecting active segments.

public_api.name: rolling_nanmedian
public_api.role: Function that applies centered rolling median ignoring NaN values; output length matches input and pads ends with NaN so every frame gets a full-width window.

public_api.name: WRIST_L, WRIST_R, ANKLE_L, ANKLE_R
public_api.role: Module constants (integers 9, 10, 15, 16) for COCO pose-keypoint indices used by stage 8 and point_winner for sticky picking and kinematics analysis.

public_api.name: StickyResult
public_api.role: NamedTuple caching sticky-evidence output: distances, picks, standing_count, ankle_pos, bbox_height (pixels), per-slot distances, wrist distance, and analysed-frame mask.
